title: Execute the active AGV command using ExecutedAgvCommand with robot ID
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API (via Apidog or equivalent) to trigger execution of the AGV’s currently active command for a specific robot ID. This is intended for unplanned restart recovery scenarios where OptiSweep may have missed callbacks from Geek Plus.
when_to_use: When recovering from an unplanned restart where OptiSweep missed callbacks from Geek Plus, and you need to execute the AGV’s currently active command for a specific robot ID.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the ExecutedAgvCommand API request for the specified robot ID and validate the API client shows an observable acceptance/success result.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client (or equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client surface)
Robot ID for the target AGV

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep / WCS API client surface (Apidog or equivalent)
system_preconditions: A valid robot ID is available for the AGV whose active command should be executed.

visual_references.description: Training segment frame listing AGV API functions including ExecutedAgvCommand and its requirement for robot ID and behavior (execute active command).

steps.title: Identify the robot ID for the AGV whose active command should be executed
steps.purpose: ExecutedAgvCommand requires a robot ID to target the correct AGV.
steps.instruction: Obtain the robot ID for the AGV that needs its currently active command executed.
steps.expected_result: You have a specific robot ID value to use in the ExecutedAgvCommand request.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot ID corresponds to the AGV you intend to recover (i.e., the target AGV is correctly identified).
steps.failure_condition: An incorrect or missing robot ID is used, causing the API request to target the wrong AGV or fail.

steps.title: Select the ExecutedAgvCommand API action in the OptiSweep / WCS API client
steps.purpose: Ensure you are using the correct API action that executes the AGV’s active command and requires a robot ID.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client surface (Apidog / WCS API), select the API action named ExecutedAgvCommand and confirm it is described as requiring the robot ID and executing the active command the AGV has.
steps.expected_result: The ExecutedAgvCommand action is selected in the API client and is ready to accept the robot ID parameter.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client shows ExecutedAgvCommand with a robot ID requirement (i.e., the request is configured to include robot ID).
steps.failure_condition: You select a different API action or configure a request that does not include the required robot ID.

steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted or is rejected due to missing/invalid robot ID.
